text: ぜんぶ　おれに　まかせれば　いーんだって！

structure.jp: ぜんぶ　おれに　まかせれば
structure.en: if you leave it all to me

patterns.name: 〜ばいい
patterns.explanation: ばいい says 'if you do this, it is fine', which is a way of saying 'just do this'. いー is a casual stretched いい. まかせれば いー = 'you should just leave it (to me)'.

patterns.name: 〜んだ
patterns.explanation: んだ after a word gives it the feel of explaining or insisting. いーんだ = 'it's fine, that's how it is'.

patterns.name: 〜って (insisting)
patterns.explanation: って at the very end of a sentence says 'I'm telling you', as if repeating yourself to someone who won't listen. いーんだって = 'it's fine, I'm telling you!'
